_README: COPY THIS to stocks/<TICKER>.json and fill it in. Delete these _ fields. Every number must come from a real source — if you cannot find one, use null. A null renders as an honest dash in the UI; a guessed number breaks the entire product promise.
name: Bharat Electronics Ltd
_business: TWO plain sentences. No jargon. Write it as if explaining to someone who has never bought a share. Hand-write this — do not paste the company's own marketing copy.
business: Bharat Electronics makes radar, communications and electronic warfare systems. Most of its customers are Indian defence services.
_price: sourceId must match a file in documents/. Usually your BSE market-data doc.
_metrics: key must be one of: pe, eps, market_cap, book_value, debt_to_equity, roe, roce, dividend_yield, promoter_holding, week52_range. Leave explanation as "" — the AI writes it at the user's level at runtime. direction is high|low|normal|unknown compared to sectorMedian.
_history: Daily closes, 1 year is plenty. From screener.in chart API. Can be [] initially.
_sectorMedians: Needed for every 'compared to its sector' line in the product. Compute across the stocks you have in the same sector.
_risk: NEVER a bare level. Every row needs a plain-English reason AND sources. key must be one of: volatility, debt, valuation, stability.

risk.label: Price volatility
risk.reason: Write the actual reason here, in one sentence.
